4//! Shared helpers for pixel-space filter operations.

6use crate::third_party::vello_common::color::palette::css::TRANSPARENT;
7#[cfg(any())]
8use crate::third_party::vello_common::kurbo::common::FloatFuncs as _;
9use crate::third_party::vello_common::peniko::color::PremulRgba8;
10use crate::third_party::vello_common::pixmap::Pixmap;

12/// Shift all pixels in a pixmap by the given offset.
13///
14/// This implements the offset operation in-place by copying pixels to their new positions.
15/// The iteration order is carefully chosen based on shift direction to avoid overwriting
16/// source pixels before they're read. Areas that become exposed (due to the shift) are
17/// filled with transparent black. Pixels that would move outside the bounds are discarded.
18pub(crate) fn offset_pixels(pixmap: &mut Pixmap, dx: f32, dy: f32) {
19    let dx_pixels = dx.round() as i32;
20    let dy_pixels = dy.round() as i32;
21
22    // Early return if no offset
23    if dx_pixels == 0 && dy_pixels == 0 {
24        return;
25    }
26
27    let width = pixmap.width();
28    let height = pixmap.height();
29    let transparent = TRANSPARENT.premultiply().to_rgba8();
30
31    // Process pixels in the correct order to avoid overwriting source data.
32    // Key insight: iterate away from the direction of movement.
33    // This allows us to move pixels in-place without a temporary buffer.
34    //
35    // Use match to eliminate Box<dyn Iterator> allocation overhead and enable
36    // better compiler optimization through static dispatch.
37    match (dx_pixels >= 0, dy_pixels >= 0) {
38        (true, true) => {
39            // Shift right+down: iterate bottom-to-top, right-to-left
40            for y in (0..height).rev() {
41                for x in (0..width).rev() {
42                    process_offset_pixel(pixmap, x, y, dx_pixels, dy_pixels, width, height, transparent);
43                }
44            }
45        }
46        (true, false) => {
47            // Shift right+up: iterate top-to-bottom, right-to-left
48            for y in 0..height {
49                for x in (0..width).rev() {
50                    process_offset_pixel(pixmap, x, y, dx_pixels, dy_pixels, width, height, transparent);
51                }
52            }
53        }
54        (false, true) => {
55            // Shift left+down: iterate bottom-to-top, left-to-right
56            for y in (0..height).rev() {
57                for x in 0..width {
58                    process_offset_pixel(pixmap, x, y, dx_pixels, dy_pixels, width, height, transparent);
59                }
60            }
61        }
62        (false, false) => {
63            // Shift left+up: iterate top-to-bottom, left-to-right
64            for y in 0..height {
65                for x in 0..width {
66                    process_offset_pixel(pixmap, x, y, dx_pixels, dy_pixels, width, height, transparent);
67                }
68            }
69        }
70    }
71}
72
73/// Process a single pixel during offset operation.
74///
75/// This moves the pixel to its new position (if in bounds) and clears the source
76/// position if it's in the exposed region.
77#[inline(always)]
78fn process_offset_pixel(pixmap: &mut Pixmap, x: u16, y: u16, dx_pixels: i32, dy_pixels: i32, width: u16, height: u16, transparent: PremulRgba8) {
79    let new_x = x as i32 + dx_pixels;
80    let new_y = y as i32 + dy_pixels;
81
82    if new_x >= 0 && new_x < width as i32 && new_y >= 0 && new_y < height as i32 {
83        let pixel = pixmap.sample(x, y);
84        pixmap.set_pixel(new_x as u16, new_y as u16, pixel);
85    }
86
87    // Clear the source pixel if it's in the exposed region
88    let should_clear = (dx_pixels > 0 && x < dx_pixels as u16)
89        || (dx_pixels < 0 && x >= (width as i32 + dx_pixels) as u16)
90        || (dy_pixels > 0 && y < dy_pixels as u16)
91        || (dy_pixels < 0 && y >= (height as i32 + dy_pixels) as u16);
92
93    if should_clear {
94        pixmap.set_pixel(x, y, transparent);
95    }
96}

98#[cfg(any())]
99mod tests {
100    use super::*;
101
102    /// Test `offset_pixels` with positive offset (right and down).
103    #[cfg(any())]
104    fn test_offset_pixels_positive() {
105        let mut pixmap = Pixmap::new(4, 4);
106        // Set center pixel to white
107        pixmap.set_pixel(1, 1, PremulRgba8 { r: 255, g: 255, b: 255, a: 255 });
108
109        offset_pixels(&mut pixmap, 1.0, 1.0);
110
111        // White pixel should have moved from (1,1) to (2,2)
112        let moved = pixmap.sample(2, 2);
113        assert_eq!(moved.a, 255);
114
115        // Original position should be cleared (in exposed region)
116        let cleared = pixmap.sample(1, 1);
117        assert_eq!(cleared.a, 0);
118    }
119
120    /// Test `offset_pixels` with negative offset (left and up).
121    #[cfg(any())]
122    fn test_offset_pixels_negative() {
123        let mut pixmap = Pixmap::new(4, 4);
124        // Set pixel at (2,2) to white
125        pixmap.set_pixel(2, 2, PremulRgba8 { r: 255, g: 255, b: 255, a: 255 });
126
127        offset_pixels(&mut pixmap, -1.0, -1.0);
128
129        // White pixel should have moved from (2,2) to (1,1)
130        let moved = pixmap.sample(1, 1);
131        assert_eq!(moved.a, 255);
132
133        // Original position should be cleared (in exposed region)
134        let cleared = pixmap.sample(2, 2);
135        assert_eq!(cleared.a, 0);
136    }
137
138    /// Test `offset_pixels` with fractional offset (should round).
139    #[cfg(any())]
140    fn test_offset_pixels_fractional() {
141        let mut pixmap = Pixmap::new(4, 4);
142        pixmap.set_pixel(1, 1, PremulRgba8 { r: 255, g: 255, b: 255, a: 255 });
143
144        // 0.6 rounds to 1, -0.4 rounds to 0
145        offset_pixels(&mut pixmap, 0.6, -0.4);
146
147        // Should move by (1, 0): from (1,1) to (2,1)
148        let moved = pixmap.sample(2, 1);
149        assert_eq!(moved.a, 255);
150    }
151
152    /// Test `offset_pixels` with out-of-bounds offset (should clip).
153    #[cfg(any())]
154    fn test_offset_pixels_out_of_bounds() {
155        let mut pixmap = Pixmap::new(4, 4);
156        pixmap.set_pixel(1, 1, PremulRgba8 { r: 255, g: 255, b: 255, a: 255 });
157
158        // Large offset that moves pixel outside bounds
159        offset_pixels(&mut pixmap, 10.0, 10.0);
160
161        // Pixel moves outside, so (1,1) should be cleared
162        let cleared = pixmap.sample(1, 1);
163        assert_eq!(cleared.a, 0);
164
165        // All pixels should be cleared (entire image is exposed region)
166        for y in 0..4 {
167            for x in 0..4 {
168                assert_eq!(pixmap.sample(x, y).a, 0);
169            }
170        }
171    }
172}
